gen-dafont-redux-gf-marcellus-sc: Contemporary and widely spaced, Redux swings into every curve with a very visible run-up. Marcellus SC, a serif with gentle modulation and lowercase as stately as cast iron capitals, adds dignified weight.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-montagu-slab: Redux spaces its letters wide and makes a visible entrance into every curve. It earns its keep large and brief, while Montagu Slab, a serif, mixes robust downstrokes with slender turns and an open e.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-serif-hentaigan: Refined and traditional, Noto Serif Hentaigana is a text serif whose open-jawed curves and near-capital small letters sit under wide-set Redux. Paragraphs would read steadily, with subtle stroke modulation keeping the eye moving.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-ovo: Ovo reads authoritative and classic, with spacious curve endings. Give that text serif a larger size so its tall middle band and shallow ascenders show, while Redux keeps its wide spacing up top.
gen-dafont-sf-wonder-comic-gf-domine: Domine reads dignified, compact and a touch pinched at the joins. Against the dense, tall-middled words of SF Wonder Comic and its half-finished bowls, those open curves give each line somewhere to breathe.
gen-dafont-sf-wonder-comic-gf-esteban: Dense, tall-middled, half-open bowls: that's SF Wonder Comic. Esteban, a serif with thin parts barely slimmer than its stems and an e that stays open, gives those quirks a steadier surface.
gen-dafont-sf-wonder-comic-gf-faustina: Words in SF Wonder Comic look dense and tall in the middle, with bowls left unfinished on one side. Faustina, a text serif whose bowls thin gently, supplies the best part: a classic, authoritative counterpoint.
gen-dafont-sf-wonder-comic-gf-halant: Halant, a text serif, has a faint but real thick-thin shift and terminals pointing outward. Halant carries the sustained reading, while SF Wonder Comic grabs attention with dense, tall-middled words.
gen-dafont-sf-wonder-comic-gf-lisu-bosa: Lisu Bosa lets its counters spill into surrounding space, making tall lowercase look sturdy next to SF Wonder Comic. Long paragraphs would read with a lightly springy, editorial rhythm.
gen-dafont-sf-wonder-comic-gf-marcellus-: Marcellus SC reads dignified and literary, a text serif with gentle modulation and pulled-back terminals. And SF Wonder Comic, dense and tall in the middle, supplies the striking opener above it.
